name: Solo.io kgateway / Gloo Gateway CRD Structure
description: JSON structure documentation for Solo.io kgateway (Gloo Gateway) Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions

resources.name: Upstream
resources.description: Backend service destination for Gloo Gateway traffic routing

spec.aws: AWS Lambda function list with region and credentials
spec.ai: AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex AI, Gemini, Ollama)

resources.name: VirtualService
resources.description: HTTP routing rules, domain bindings, and traffic policies

virtualHost.routes: Ordered route rules with matchers and actions
virtualHost.options: Rate limiting, auth, CORS, transformation options

resources.name: RouteTable
resources.description: Delegated route configuration for multi-team API management

spec.weight: Ordering weight for route table selection

resources.name: Gateway
resources.description: Envoy listener configuration binding ports to virtual services

resources.name: GatewayParameters
resources.description: Envoy deployment parameters for gateway instances

resources.name: HttpListenerOption
resources.description: Policy options applied to HTTP listeners (rate limit, auth, tracing)

resources.name: ListenerOption
resources.description: Policy options applied to all listener types

resources.name: RouteOption
resources.description: Policy options applied at the route level (transformation, retries, timeouts)

resources.name: VirtualHostOption
resources.description: Policy options applied at the virtual host level

resources.name: AuthConfig
resources.description: External authentication configuration (OIDC, API key, OPA, passthrough)

resources.name: RateLimitConfig
resources.description: Rate limiting rules applied to gateway traffic
